states: Production Organization Overview, shared controls, guarded state, OrgsAPI, HTTP client and capability/presentation stores in an offline evidence-only shell for the existing Settings panel. Synthetic organizations, members and responses; not full App, IdP, cross-tab, original-client or installed authorization acceptance.

Exact baseline 2d8b63f1 original Panel/Details blobs are loaded at their original module paths with unchanged surrounding consuming source. Both phases use matching launch-snapshot offline-installed dependencies: Solid1.9.17, seroval1.7.3, Vite6.4.5. A stale canonical-tree diagnostic was explicitly superseded, not counted as exact dependency proof.

Chromium141.0.7390.37 and WebKit26.0 via Playwright1.56.1 matching the integration lock; light/dark desktop and narrow. Native Enter previously sent0 writes and now sends exactly1 PUT with the trimmed name, exact organization/CSRF and no API-token fallback. Pending Enter does not send another write.

Applied-but-unconfirmed response withdraws the editor and focuses its named warning; explicit keyboard Reload performs saved reads only and focuses the saved editable name. Confirmed save reloads and focuses the saved name. Deliberate outside focus and changed organization win; read-only controls stay disabled.
Nonmanager initial read failures do not take focus. Explicit recovery focuses the existing saved-name summary, keeping input/Save disabled and the existing membership guidance. No write occurs.

48 retained captures,24 comparable pairs, all opened natively with view_image and reviewed. Whole-page initial states preserve organization name/ID/created date/member count, exact member identities, roles and desktop dates. Recovery rings do not move or hide content; no aggregation or loss.

Hold the mutation, inspect disabled controls, then return uncertainty after a synthetic apply and inspect the warning/focus.
Activate Reload with the keyboard and verify saved readback, no write replay and usable focus.
Submit a confirmed second rename and inspect its resulting saved snapshot.
Move focus outside during a held read and change the selected organization; verify no focus is reclaimed.
Recover an initially unavailable nonmanager read; inspect the saved-name focus and unchanged disabled controls.
